observations.contract: Zero end scales on a top-level shaft
observations.trace: A recipe with no components and one shaft is permitted. Choose length0.1m, radius0.01m, bottom_scale=0, top_scale=0, no tenon, no wrappings and default segments. The root validator requires positive nominal length/radius and only an upper bound on radius times the maximum scale; the selected wrapping/tenon check has nothing further to validate. The shaft profile is [[0,0],[0.1,0]]. Construction passes that profile to lathe with positive radial_scale and default requested segments. The radial solid path has no positive-radius side triangles and skips both zero-radius caps; absent wrappings, its PartSource has zero mass. PhysicalProperties divides its zero moment by zero mass, and also divides zero total first moment by zero total mass, yielding nonfinite centers under IEEE arithmetic. At zero radius, the high-detail radial calculation reaches NaN for sagitta/radius; the pinned Rust Reference states its integer cast yields0, so the positive requested/floor segment count remains. The small example stays below the construction budget in source reasoning.
observations.remaining: Source-only symbolic reasoning; no recipe, validator, profile, lathe, model, physical calculation or test ran. The original grip zero-scale finding and authored ornament case share finite physical-output ownership but use distinct admission and producer paths; exact deduplication and actual authoring/gameplay reachability remain open.

observations.trace: For the same shaft-only shape with ordinary positive end scales and length0.1m, placement registers shaft.bottom at0 and shaft.top at0.1m. With no shield, explicit grip role, grip aliases or grip_clearance, grip_point selects the shaft fallback: it clamps 20% of shaft length to a minimum0.18m, divides by length and lerps between bottom and top. That yields a control point approximately0.18m, beyond the top by approximately0.08m. Root admission allows such positive length and radius.
observations.remaining: This is symbolic source reasoning on a short direct recipe, not a generated model, observed hand position or proof a normal authoring path offers the input. Canonical minimum handle length and consumer impact remain policy/reachability questions; this is separate from zero end-scale mass.

Exact other producer outcomes, native error presentation and shared error owner remain open. Profile, terminal and mace validators check lengths before selected first/last unwraps, while shaft wrapping support indices point strictly backward before the later ancestry traversal.
